name: Cricketers LMS 18/09
result: No winner. Out in Week 1 (Forest). The last 3 drew with Villa in Week 5, so the pot rolled into Cricketers LMS 06/11.

history.note: Picks: Man City 16, Forest 15, Leeds 3, Newcastle 3, Everton 1, Aston Villa 1, Hull 1, Spurs 1. Forest lost 0-1 at home to promoted Coventry, taking out 15. Leeds drew 0-0 with Palace, Hull and Spurs lost.
Picks: Arsenal 9, Newcastle 5, Chelsea 3, Aston Villa 1, Spurs 1, Brighton 1, Ipswich 1. Newcastle lost 4-1 at Coventry, taking out 5. Villa drew with Brentford, Spurs drew at Man Utd.
Picks: Brighton 5, Spurs 4, Man City 2, Bournemouth 1, Arsenal 1, Hull 1. Only Hull lost (0-1 at Fulham). Spurs, Brighton, City, Bournemouth and Arsenal all won.
Picks: Chelsea 6, Arsenal 3, Brentford 2, Coventry 1, Man Utd 1. Chelsea lost 0-2 at home to Spurs, taking out 6. Brentford drew at Hull, Man Utd and Coventry lost. Only the 3 on Arsenal survived.
Picks: Aston Villa 3. All 3 on Villa at home to Fulham. Draw, so nobody won and the pot rolled over.

flags: 41 entries. Two pile-ons on teams playing promoted Coventry took out 20: Forest (15) in Week 1 and Newcastle away (5) in Week 2.
Home picks: 79 of 92 (86%). They won 48 of 79 (61%); away picks won 3 of 13.
Picks against promoted sides (Coventry, Ipswich, Hull): 32, won 10.
Big teams went early: 16 of 41 used Man City in Week 1 and 9 of 21 survivors used Arsenal in Week 2.
Two of the last three made identical picks all five weeks.
pileons: Week 1: Man City 16 and Forest 15 of 41. City won, Forest lost.
Week 2: Arsenal 9 and Newcastle 5 of 21. Arsenal won, Newcastle lost.
Week 3: Brighton 5 and Spurs 4 of 14. Both won.
Week 4: Chelsea 6 of 13. Lost at home to Spurs.
